chunks.head: give up
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式（gave them up），故 card-only。give up sth = 放弃、停止做某事。

literal.note_cn: 此处非“给予”，须与 up 合看

chunks.head: choke back
chunks.note: choke back = 拼命咽下、忍住即将涌出的哭声或眼泪。
chunks.ex_en: He choked back his tears and kept smiling.
chunks.ex_cn: 他强忍住眼泪，继续微笑。

chunks.head: so-and-so
chunks.note: 泛指不便或不必具体说明的人或事，相当于“某某、如此这般”。

literal.note_cn: 习语固定用词，单独无实义

chunks.ex_en: She kept saying she did so-and-so, but gave no details.
chunks.ex_cn: 她一直说自己做了这样那样的事，却不说细节。

chunks.head: this and that
chunks.note: 泛指零零碎碎、不重要的各种事情。
chunks.ex_en: We chatted about this and that for an hour.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们东拉西扯地聊了一个小时。

chunks.head: point out
chunks.note: point out = 指出（事实、错误或某处位置）。
chunks.ex_en: The teacher pointed out my spelling mistakes.
chunks.ex_cn: 老师指出了我的拼写错误。

chunks.head: more or less
chunks.note: 表示大致如此，或程度上多多少少有一些。
chunks.ex_en: The two bags weigh more or less the same.

chunks.head: in keeping with
chunks.note: 表示与某事物相协调、相称。
chunks.ex_en: His quiet manner was in keeping with the solemn day.
chunks.ex_cn: 他安静的举止与这肃穆的日子很相称。

chunks.head: at intervals
chunks.gloss: 每隔一段时间；断断续续地
chunks.note: 指某动作按时间间隔反复发生。
chunks.ex_en: The lighthouse flashed at intervals through the night.
chunks.ex_cn: 灯塔整夜里每隔一会儿闪一次光。

chunks.head: give way to
chunks.gloss: 屈从于；(感情)抑制不住而失控
chunks.note: give way to sth = 抵挡不住而屈服；本章指牧师压不住自己的情绪。

literal.note_cn: give way 意为让路、让步

chunks.ex_en: She finally gave way to her anger and shouted.
chunks.ex_cn: 她终于压不住怒火，喊了出来。

chunks.head: pour out
chunks.note: pour out = 把（话语、感情）一股脑说出来；也指把液体倒出。本章为倾吐感激之情。
chunks.ex_en: She poured out all her worries to her best friend.
chunks.ex_cn: 她把所有烦恼都向最好的朋友倾诉了。

chunks.head: at the top of one's voice
chunks.gloss: 用最大的嗓门；扯着嗓子
chunks.note: 指尽可能大声地喊叫或说话。
chunks.ex_en: The children sang at the top of their voices.
chunks.ex_cn: 孩子们扯着嗓子放声歌唱。
occ: at the top of his voice

chunks.head: break down
chunks.gloss: (情绪)崩溃；(机器)出故障；(体力)垮掉
chunks.note: 本章指众人情绪失控、放声大哭。也可指机器抛锚或身体垮掉。
chunks.ex_en: She broke down and cried when she heard the news.
chunks.ex_cn: 听到那消息，她崩溃大哭。

skipped: the Harpers / Aunt Polly / Becky / Tom / Joe / Huck / Old Hundred / Sabbath (专名/人名/圣咏名，不收)
andiron-knob / paling fence (一次性名物描写)
in all conscience (古旧口语，一次性)
took upon themselves (较文学化，控量舍去)
gaped at / loitered away / slink away (一次性/较冷僻)
blinded himself to / spread his hands abroad (文学性古旧，一次性→难句层)
bid for glory / rank rascalities / awful prophecy (一次性描写组合)
more and more / according to / of course (偏基础/语法化)
